description: This file defines the NewsletterController class in the Goteo project, responsible for handling newsletter-related actions such as displaying the last newsletter to users with the indexAction method.

classes.name: NewsletterController
classes.description: Controller class for managing newsletters, including displaying the latest newsletter and fetching newsletter data from the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NewsletterController, sets database read replica, cache, and view theme.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Fetches and displays the most recent newsletter, optionally filtered by ID, including content, subject, and related communication data.
